title: Main Takeaways, Exercises and Extra- Curriculum

cues.en: We finished up the last video with two big thumbs up.
cues.zh: 上支影片最後，得到兩個大大的讚。

cues.en: We saw the power of transfer learning and the power of experiment tracking.
cues.zh: 看到遷移學習與實驗追蹤的力量。

cues.en: So let's jump into here.
cues.zh: 進到這裡。

cues.en: Let's wrap up Milestone Project one PyTorch Experiment Tracking.
cues.zh: 收尾里程碑專案一，PyTorch 實驗追蹤。

cues.en: If you go into this section number seven, we scroll down here.
cues.zh: 到第 7 章，往下。

cues.en: I've summarized some of the main takeaways from this section.
cues.zh: 總結本章幾個主要重點。

cues.en: And the most beautiful thing is that we've now gone full circle.
cues.zh: 最美好的，是現在已走完一整圈。

cues.en: So right back in the PyTorch workflow fundamentals.
cues.zh: 回到 PyTorch 工作流程基礎。

cues.en: What did we say the workflow was?
cues.zh: 當時說流程是什麼？

cues.en: Get data ready.
cues.zh: 準備資料。

cues.en: We turn it into tenses.
cues.zh: 轉成張量。

cues.en: We've done that plenty of times.
cues.zh: 做過很多次。

cues.en: Pick or build a pre-trained model to suit your problem, create a loss function and optimizer build a training loop.
cues.zh: 選擇或建立適合問題的預訓練模型，建立損失函數與最佳化器，建立訓練迴圈。

cues.en: We've put all a lot of this code into going modular, so engine py creates all of our training loop for us.
cues.zh: 很多程式放進 going_modular，所以 engine.py 替我們建立所有訓練迴圈。

cues.en: We fit the model to the data and we make a prediction.
cues.zh: 讓模型擬合資料，再做預測。

cues.en: We saw how to evaluate it both quantitatively and qualitatively.
cues.zh: 看過定量與定性評估。

cues.en: Making predictions on our images, we've now improved through experimentation.
cues.zh: 對影像預測，現在也透過實驗改善。

cues.en: The whole point of this section was to set up programmatic experiment tracking, adhering to the machine learning practitioner's model of experiment, experiment, experiment, and then save and reload your
cues.zh: 本章重點，是建立程式化實驗追蹤，遵循實務工作者口訣，實驗、實驗、再實驗；然後儲存與重新載入，

cues.en: train model.
cues.zh: 訓練好的模型。

cues.en: Well, we've just done that and made predictions on our own custom data, so we've gone full circle.
cues.zh: 剛剛已做完，也預測自己的自訂資料，所以完整走了一圈。

cues.en: Give yourself a pat on the back because that is no small feat.
cues.zh: 為自己拍拍肩膀，這不是小事。

cues.en: So the main ideas we should take away from this is of course, the machine learning Practitioners motto Experiment, experiment, experiment.
cues.zh: 主要概念，當然是實務工作者口訣：實驗、實驗、再實驗。

cues.en: But yes, of course, we've been doing plenty of that already in the beginning.
cues.zh: 對，當然，從一開始就做了很多。

cues.en: Keep your experiments small so you can work fast.
cues.zh: 保持實驗小規模，才能工作得快。

cues.en: Your first few experiments shouldn't take more than a few seconds to a few minutes.
cues.zh: 前幾個實驗不應超過幾秒到幾分鐘。

cues.en: And we did that.
cues.zh: 我們做到了。

cues.en: We saw running eight models in about 5 minutes.
cues.zh: 約五分鐘跑八個模型。

cues.en: In fact, you could probably do quicker than that.
cues.zh: 其實可能還能更快。

cues.en: And so the more experiments you do, the quicker you can figure out what doesn't work.
cues.zh: 所以實驗越多，越能快速找出什麼無效。

cues.en: And what does that mean?
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: That's the whole point of science, right?
cues.zh: 這就是科學重點，對吧？

cues.en: If you figure out what doesn't work, you can figure out what does work.
cues.zh: 找出什麼無效，才能找出什麼有效。

cues.en: And when you do, find out what does work, scale up.
cues.zh: 發現有效方法後，再擴大。

cues.en: So for example, since our best performing model is now efficient Net B2, perhaps you'd like to now see what happens when you scale that up to the whole photo One data set.
cues.zh: 例如現在最佳是 EfficientNet-B2，也許想看看擴大到整個 Food-101 資料集會如何。

cues.en: Oh my gosh.
cues.zh: 天啊。

cues.en: Food 101.
cues.zh: Food-101。

cues.en: That is from provisioned data sets.
cues.zh: 來自 torchvision.datasets。

cues.en: In fact, I wouldn't even recommend going straight to the whole data set.
cues.zh: 其實不建議直接跳整個資料集。

cues.en: I'd probably just start on all 101 classes, but only 10% of the images.
cues.zh: 我大概會先用全部 101 類，但只用 10% 影像。

cues.en: See if you can give that a go.
cues.zh: 看看能不能試。

cues.en: And then finally, programmatically tracking your experiments takes a few steps to set up like we saw creating a writer and Tensor Bourne and whatnot.
cues.zh: 最後，程式化追蹤需要幾個設定步驟，像剛才建立 writer、TensorBoard 等。

cues.en: But in the long run it's worth it.
cues.zh: 不過長遠很值得。

cues.en: So you can visually inspect multiple experiments in one time.
cues.zh: 能同時視覺檢查多個實驗。

cues.en: And of course, there are many different machine learning experiment trackers out there, and we've got that up here.
cues.zh: 當然，有許多機器學習實驗追蹤器，上面這裡。

cues.en: How do you track a model?
cues.zh: 如何追蹤模型？

cues.en: Different ways to track machine learning experiments?
cues.zh: 不同機器學習實驗追蹤方法。

cues.en: We've looked at tens of world because it's baked into PyTorch.
cues.zh: 看了 TensorBoard，因為內建整合於 PyTorch。

cues.en: There's also weights and biases to experiment tracking one of my favorites and there's also ML Flow, which is a great open source ML ops lifecycle library.
cues.zh: 也有我很喜歡的 Weights & Biases，還有 MLflow，很棒的開源 MLOps 生命週期函式庫。

cues.en: And if we come right back down to the bottom, I've got some exercises prepared for you.
cues.zh: 回最下面，準備了一些練習。

cues.en: So three exercises here, picking a larger model, trying out data augmentation, and then if we go down here.
cues.zh: 三個練習，選更大模型、嘗試資料增強，再往下，

cues.en: Scaling up if you really wanted to.
cues.zh: 真想要的話，擴大規模。

cues.en: And then of course, there's some extra curriculum that I'll let you explore on your own.
cues.zh: 當然，也有延伸學習，留給你自己探索。

cues.en: But congratulations.
cues.zh: 不過恭喜。

cues.en: You've now finished the Milestone Project One PyTorch experiment Tracking.
cues.zh: 完成里程碑專案一，PyTorch 實驗追蹤。

cues.en: Oh, and just a little tidbit.
cues.zh: 哦，補充一下。

cues.en: There is an exercise template notebook for number seven and a solutions notebook for number seven.
cues.zh: 有第 7 章練習模板筆記本，以及第 7 章解答筆記本。

cues.en: So here these are both available on GitHub, but you've got the links to those.
cues.zh: 兩者都在 GitHub，這裡有連結。

cues.en: I'll let you go through both of them.
cues.zh: 留給你逐一看。

cues.en: So there we go, template and potential solutions.
cues.zh: 所以模板與可能解答。

cues.en: So we'll get out of that.
cues.zh: 關掉這個。

cues.en: Well, we're running out of sections here.
cues.zh: 嗯，剩下章節越來越少。

cues.en: Well, I'll keep the next one a sacred.
cues.zh: 下一章先保密。

cues.en: I'll see you there.
cues.zh: 到時見。
